title: Pumpkin Seeds Daily Benefits

scenes.text: Eating 100 grams of pumpkin seeds daily boosts protein intake
One hundred grams provides about 30 grams of protein.
The same serving supplies roughly 5 grams of fiber, supporting digestion.
Add a handful daily for protein and gut health.
